data.body: [P2] The successful result is still published before the try-with-resources restores the worker's previous MDC. If restoration then throws an ordinary exception, `completeExceptionally` cannot replace the successful result and `rethrowFatal` ignores the cleanup failure, allowing the executor to reuse a worker with contaminated or missing MDC. Restore before publication while preserving end-hook context, or retire an asynchronous worker after any post-publication restoration failure; add a worker-reuse assertion to the ordinary-restoration-failure test.
